announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.9.2 — capture SketchUp dari layar lebar tidak lagi dianggap foto 360 (dulu kamera bisa pindah dan muncul gedung tambahan); hasil berkas 1K tidak lagi dirender ulang otomatis, ARA bertanya dulu; autopilot tidak lagi mengirim dua kali. Baru: mesin generate ketiga Meta AI (gratis, login akun Meta sendiri di tab Render) dan, di edisi Office, preset proyek yang terlihat di semua PC/divisi. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.9.2 — SketchUp captures from wide screens are no longer treated as 360 photos (the camera could move and extra buildings appeared); 1K results are no longer re-rendered automatically, ARA asks first; autopilot no longer sends twice. New: a third generate engine, Meta AI (free, sign in with your own Meta account in the Render tab), and in the Office edition, project presets visible on every PC/division. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
